title: Flights for Sleep
description: Airline announcements, captain's voice, flight info for sleep. The departure gate as lullaby. Boarding calls, safety briefings, altitude announcements, landing whispers.
concept: Airline announcements + cabin ambiance = the whole video. Captain speaking, boarding calls, safety briefings, altitude updates, landing announcements. Per airline, per route, accurate local style.

structure: 1. Gate announcement — 'Flight BA123 to Tokyo is now boarding at Gate B32'
2. Safety briefing — 'Ladies and gentlemen, welcome aboard...'
3. Captain's announcement — 'Good evening, this is your captain speaking...'
4. Altitude updates — 'We are now cruising at thirty-five thousand feet'
5. Turbulence — 'We may experience some light turbulence'
6. Descent — 'We are beginning our descent into Tokyo Narita'
7. Landing — 'Welcome to Tokyo. Local time is...'

audio_sources.name: Cabin ambiance
audio_sources.query: airplane cabin white noise engine hum

british_airways.voice_style: Warm, professional, reassuring. 'Good evening, ladies and gentlemen, this is your captain speaking. Welcome aboard British Airways flight BA115 to New York JFK.'
captain_phrases: Good evening, this is your captain speaking
We are currently cruising at an altitude of thirty-five thousand feet
We expect to arrive at JFK at approximately local time
Cabin crew, please prepare for landing
cabin_phrases: Please ensure your seatbelt is securely fastened
Your seatbelt should be worn whenever the seatbelt sign is illuminated
We will be dimming the cabin lights for the duration of the flight

japan_airlines.voice_style: Polite, measured, formal. 'Moshiwake arimasen ga, honjitsu wa Japan Airlines ni go-riyou itadakimashite, arigatou gozaimasu'
captain_phrases: Genzai koukuu kousoku de junbi shite imasu

lufthansa.voice_style: Efficient, direct, German precision. 'Guten Abend, meine Damen und Herren. Willkommen an Bord der Lufthansa Flug LH456 nach Frankfurt'
captain_phrases: Guten Abend, hier spricht Ihr Kapitän
Wir fliegen in einer Höhe von zehntausend Metern
Wir erwarten eine Landung um Uhr
cabin_phrases: Bitte achten Sie darauf, dass Ihr Sicherheitsgurt angelegt ist
